Using Evaluation to combat AI drift Types of AI drift in simple terms Concept Drift: This happens when the relationship between inputs and outputs changes. ○ For example, a word might change its meaning over time, like how "sick" used to mean ill but now can also mean something cool . This occurs when the input data changes.○ For instance, if customers start using new terminology that the model hasn't seen before, it might not understand the new ter ms. • New Section 1 Page 76 Prediction Drift: This is when the distribution of the model's predictions changes due to external factors. ○ For example, if there's a sudden increase in technical support queries during an outage, the model's predictions will shift a ccordingly. This happens when the actual labels or categories change. ○ For example, a new product might introduce new types of customer issues, requiring new labels for those issues.○• Evaluation Methods: Evaluation can be done explicitly with labeled ground truth sets or implicitly by monitoring downstream metrics. • Both methods help in detecting and addressing drift.• Periodic Retraining: Regularly updating and retraining models with new data can help combat drift and improve model accuracy over time.• Time Series Regression Code for time series regression Time_regr ession_fr...
